      - listitem:
        - link "Moderators approval":
          - /url: ""
  - heading "Moderators approval" [level=2]
  - region "Give your workflow a name*":

      - /url: "#panel-name-section"
    - button "Toggle section" [expanded]
    - heading "Give your workflow a name*" [level=2]
    - textbox "Give your workflow a name*": Moderators approval

    - link "Add tasks to your workflow":
      - /url: "#panel-add_tasks_to_your_workflow-section"
    - button "Toggle section" [expanded]
    - heading "Add tasks to your workflow" [level=2]
    - region "Task 1":
      - link "Task 1":
        - /url: "#inline_child_workflow_tasks-0-panel-section"
      - button "Toggle section" [expanded]
      - heading "Task 1" [level=2]
      - button "Move up" [disabled]
      - button "Move down" [disabled]
      - button "Drag"
      - button "Delete"
      - text: Task* Moderators approval
      - button "Actions"
    - button "Add task"
  - region "Assign your workflow to pages":
    - link "Assign your workflow to pages":
      - /url: "#workflow-pages-section"
    - button "Toggle section" [expanded]
    - heading "Assign your workflow to pages" [level=2]
    - paragraph:
      - text: Workflows apply to child pages too. If you select a parent page here, its child pages will also use this workflow. See

      - rowgroup:
        - row "Page Action":

          - cell "Delete":
            - button "Delete"

          - cell "Page* Choose a page":
            - text: Page*
            - button "Choose a page"
          - cell "Delete":
            - button "Delete"
    - paragraph:
      - button "Assign to another page"
  - region "Assign your workflow to snippets":
    - link "Assign your workflow to snippets":
      - /url: "#workflow-content-types-section"
    - button "Toggle section" [expanded]
    - heading "Assign your workflow to snippets" [level=2]
    - text: Content types
    - checkbox "Person" [checked]
    - text: Person
  - navigation "Actions (footer)":
    - button "Save":
      - emphasis: Save
    - button "More actions"
